notes.title: New Patch, Trailer, and Mobile Release Announcement
notes.content:
That's right folks, 
CASTLE BATTLES IS COMING TO IOS AND ANDROID! APRIL 25TH, 2017!!!

Plus, we put out a fat PATCH that'll get yall battling like never before!

As we've prepped for the mobile version of the game, we've been listening to community feedback. Now we've added a few features to improve play.

- First, there is now an option to turn off the trippy, blur effect. We heard some players were straining their eyes at times during gameplay. Now if you encounter this issue, you can simply turn it off and keep battling.

- Second, we added a cheat option to skip levels. You still "don't deserve an easy mode," but if you're more inclined to finish the story than personally beat every level, you can now do so. 

- Third, a bevy of minor enhancements to play and bug fixes. We also put out a linux version of the game. Let us know if you encounter any issues with it in the forum.

Once again,
CASTLE BATTLES IS COMING TO IOS AND ANDROID! APRIL 25TH, 2017!!!

Check out the sweet new trailer and tell your fam:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zTIPfk32XcU&t
